name: Waje version experience and reward-risk watch

policy.release_confirmation: Only a manifest with status=released creates a version experience task. A configuration revision change alone is a candidate signal, not production-release evidence.
policy.experience_scope: Use an explicitly authorized test or sandbox account where possible. A production observation may only follow normal single-account user paths.
policy.abuse_testing: Validate eligibility, idempotency, asset separation, configuration transition and reconciliation controls. Do not create multiple accounts, bypass identity/anti-fraud controls, automate repeated claims, attempt concurrency races, or seek external-payment or withdrawal profit.
